title: To propose an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022, relating to Greene County, to provide legislative findings; to provide for the pari-mutuel wagering on historical horse racing on computerized machines; to levy a tax on pari-mutuel wagering on historical horse races on computerized machines; to provide for application for licensure and the operation of a racetrack; and to provide for the distribution of taxes, fees, and other monies collected by the commission.
